admission.justification: Code validity gating is proved by the named passing row-gate case; single-file member of the family.

applicability: Every code the guard places on a short form and every row case producing one.
conditions: A code is an ASCII identifier of at most 120 chars.
A malformed code is replaced with invalid-code; the original stays whole in the detail file.
exclusions: The ok field, which the guard never cuts; error is cut to 600 chars then shrunk to fit 400 with errorCut.
Producer-internal codes that never reach an answer.
statement: A valid code is an ASCII identifier of at most 120 chars, never dropped and never cut; anything else is a producer defect surfaced before logging.
